# Morgan Dollar

The Morgan dollar is a United States silver dollar struck from 1878 to
1904, and again in 1921. It was designed by George T. Morgan, whose
initial M appears on both obverse and reverse.

The coin is composed of 90% silver and 10% copper, weighs 26.73 grams,
and has a diameter of 38.1 mm. Most of the silver came from the
Comstock Lode in Nevada.

Mintage took place at [[Philadelphia Mint|Philadelphia]], New Orleans,
San Francisco, Carson City, and (in 1921 only) Denver. Carson City
issues carry the CC mintmark and command the strongest collector
premiums.

See [[Coin Silver Standards]] for alloy background and
[[Grading and Condition]] for how wear affects value.
